field_principles.attack_classes: The full attack list is explicit and data-independent.
field_principles.attack_manifest_path_hash_and_preoutcome: The manifest path and hash prove attacks were frozen before outcome-sensitive reads.
field_principles.duration_s: Wall time is measured without padding.
field_principles.exact_oracle_claim_boundary: Exact checks are named, while statistical and lifecycle audit checks are not all-oracle.
field_principles.fail_closed_count_by_attack_class: Each attack class records its fail-closed count and decision.
field_principles.field_principles: Every required field has a reason.
field_principles.field_provenance: Every field maps to spec, upstream bytes, manifest, attacks, tests, or hashes.
field_principles.generated_label_count: Bare zero proves no generated labels were used.
field_principles.honest_verdict: The verdict uses a terminal prefix and separates safety readiness from utility promotion.
field_principles.inference_substrate: The substrate declares deterministic artifact replay with no LLM and no model load.
field_principles.information_isolation_contract: The audit declares the allowed read order and forbidden outcome leaks.
field_principles.llm_call_count: Bare zero proves no LLM call was made.
field_principles.missing_upstream_and_skipped_utility_han: Missing, skipped, and corrupted upstream classes block or skip utility without becoming safety success.
field_principles.optional_stopping_peeking_reset_duplicat: E-process and identity attacks fail closed.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Preconditions state which hashes, seeds, attacks, rollback identities, limits, and protected files froze first.
field_principles.protected_files_unchanged: Protected repo files and upstream artifacts remain byte-identical.
field_principles.protected_validation_leak_count: Bare zero proves protected validation did not leak into selection.
field_principles.protected_validation_read_reuse_and_budg: Protected validation and budget attacks fail closed.
field_principles.random_seeds: Manifest, attack, corruption, and rollback seeds are pinned.
field_principles.rationale_counterexample_lineage_certifi: Lifecycle and destructive-state attacks fail closed.
field_principles.restart_corruption_and_rollback_failure_: Restart and rollback attacks restore parent bytes.
field_principles.rollback_byte_identity: Parent rollback receipts compare canonical bytes and hashes.
field_principles.safety_ready_score: Readiness is one only when all safety, rollback, missing-evidence, protected-file, and test gates pass.
field_principles.source_model_mutation_results: Source model mutation attempts fail closed.
field_principles.source_model_weight_mutation_count: Bare zero proves base model weights stayed unchanged.
field_principles.status: Terminal status follows manifest isolation, attacks, rollback, protected files, missing evidence, and tests.
field_principles.test_commands: Focused, coverage, full pytest, spec, E2E, adversarial, run, and clutter commands are named.
field_principles.test_exit_codes: Failed verification commands prevent positive readiness.
field_principles.undetected_harmful_attack_count: Bare zero proves no harmful attack escaped detection.
field_principles.unsafe_commit_count: Bare zero proves no unsafe attacked candidate committed.
field_principles.upstream_paths_hashes_and_terminal_class: Upstream bytes and terminal classes are recorded before semantic reads.
field_principles.utility_promotion_count: Bare zero proves safety-only success did not promote utility.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: This field reports the mixed boundary and names exact-oracle checks.
